opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until October *80726, 1998, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 88(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 83.1 of the Rules of this Court.
